scripts.dev: concurrently -k --success=first --names BLOCKCHAIN,CHAIN-API,BACKEND,WORKERS,FRONTEND "pnpm run dev:blockchain-node" "pnpm run dev:blockchain-api" "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run worker:all" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:marketplace-only: concurrently -k --success=first --names BACKEND,WORKERS,FRONTEND "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run worker:all" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:blockchain-node: cd blockchain && export PATH="$PWD/../.go/bin:$PATH" && export GOTOOLCHAIN=local && export TERM=dumb && yes | ignite chain serve --reset-once
scripts.worker:all: concurrently -k --success=first --names ASSIGN,REQUEUE "pnpm --filter the-marketplace-backend run worker" "pnpm --filter the-marketplace-backend run worker:requeue"
